data.narrative:
Hades Mining is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Max Werner, Björn Dressler, and Dan Gengenbach. The company has raised $22M to date. The relevant comp universe in Climate & Energy includes one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The stage-progression method is applicable here. Using total capital raised ($22M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for progression from seed to the next institutional stage yields an implied valuation of $55M. The peer-median approach is not applicable; while eight same-sector peers exist, insufficient datapoints met narrow filtering criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier)—a broader sectoral median would introduce unacceptable noise for a seed-stage company.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $47M to $63M, centered at $55M. This range reflects a ±15% band around the stage-progression implied value. The primary uncertainty is the absence of narrowly comparable seed-stage peers in the Climate & Energy space, which limits triangulation to a single method. Additional sensitivity would emerge once the company's specific technology focus, capital efficiency, and competitive positioning relative to the identified private peers can be quantified.
